title: Buchanan bilocates to Cydonia on Mars, later matched to a photo at Puthoff's

tellings.quote: And uh the first time that happened to me was with the Sedona region at Mars.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant trained in remote viewing, the military's practice of trying to describe faraway places with the mind alone, says he once felt himself actually present on Mars, in the Cydonia region (he calls it "the Sedona region"), and that what he saw was later matched to a photo at the home of Hal Puthoff, the physicist who led early remote viewing research. Buchanan tells Michels this happened to him, the first time he felt himself in two places at once.
